summary: Watched 6 Shorts (Costco, Bezos, Netflix, Las Vegas, MrBeast creators, AMC) next to their drop points; added one lesson and raised two.
why: The two biggest drops came on the line after the hook: MrBeast lost 38 points at 5.3 s on a whole list's total, Las Vegas 26 at 6.5 s on its figure times 60. Costco, the best holder (48% stayed to watch), followed its hook with a bigger twist about the same business.

findings.title: A wider total or a rescaled figure after the hook cost 26-38 points
findings.detail: v-20261113-01 -38 at 5.3 s ('Forbes' top creators made $1.02B in all', text card); v-20261114-03 -26 at 6.5 s ('How big does that get? Every hour, about $1M'). Code check since 16 Nov.

findings.title: Second lines that pass the check still lose 19-33 points
findings.detail: 16-17 Nov Shorts: gas stations -33, Disneyland -21, GTA V -21, Powerball -19 at 5.3-5.4 s. For the next review.

findings.title: Labelled frame in the best holder
findings.detail: v-20261114-02 -18 at 7.1 s over a cart under a 'ROHAN' sign.

changes.title: Lesson 1 added: the second line widens or rescales the hook
Lessons raised: real story at 5 s (#2), labelled-object frames (#6)
